source:
@@U03870@@
Off you go through
Brake and bramble.
Over hill and
Dale go ramble.
What's easily won
Is quickly undone.
海伦 and 浮士德:
What is this madness! What is this daring!
Where has moderation gone?
Horns in wood and glen are blaring!
What is this mischief! He calls this fun?

@@U03872@@
(Running in quickly, one by one.)

@@U03873@@
Swift as an arrow he sped past us!
Ignoring us, despising us!
And then he seized the wildest of us!
Here he comes dragging her in!

@@U03875@@
(Enters carrying a young girl.)

@@U03876@@
See what I’ve won!
This sturdy quarry to fan my desire.
For all her struggle,
Tl hug her and kiss her
to show her who’s master here.

@@U03878@@
Let go of me!
Who do you think you are?
I have mind and spirit
to match yours any day!
You think you've trapped me, do you?
Just you wait! You'll see!
Unhand me now, or just for fun
get your fingers burnt!

@@U03879@@
(She bursts into flame and soars upward.)
translation:
@@U03870@@
关掉你经过
刹车和荆棘。
越过山丘和
戴尔去闲逛吧。
什么容易赢得
很快就被撤消了。
海伦和浮士德：
这是什么疯狂啊！这有什么大胆的！
节制去哪儿了？
树林和幽谷中的号角正在鸣响！
这是什么祸事啊！他管这叫好玩？

@@U03872@@
（快步跑进去，一一地。）

@@U03873@@
他快如离弦的箭，从我们身边飞驰而过！
无视我们，蔑视我们！
然后他抓住了我们中最狂野的一个！
他来了，拉着她进来！

@@U03875@@
（抱着一个年轻女孩进来。）

@@U03876@@
看看我赢了什么！
这个坚固的采石场满足了我的欲望。
对于她所有的奋斗，
我拥抱她并亲吻她
让她知道谁才是这里的主人。

@@U03878@@
放开我！
你以为你是谁？
我有思想和精神
随时匹配您的！
你认为你已经困住了我，是吗？
就等你了！你会看到的！
现在松开我，或者只是为了好玩
手指被烫伤！

@@U03879@@
（她爆发出火焰并向上飞翔。）
